verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents a path-versioned API (/api/v1, with v2 endpoints tagged Experimental) and a dedicated API Deprecation Policy. The policy guarantees at least 180 days' notice before breaking changes or removals, returns 410 Gone with a pointer to the replacement, defines what counts as a breaking change, and is paired with an API Changelog. It also publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the /api/v1 endpoints. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy is honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
